## **Takeaways** by Bloomberg AI [Subscribe](https://www.bloomberg.com/subscriptions)

Stablecoin transactions reached unprecedented heights last year, buoyed by favorable policy in the US under pro-crypto President Donald Trump.

Total stablecoin transaction volumes soared 72% to $33 trillion in 2025, according to data compiled by Artemis Analytics Inc. Leading the way was USDC, a digital dollar developed by [Circle Internet Group Inc.](https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/CRCL:US), which accounted for $18.3 trillion worth of transactions, while [Tether Holdings SA](https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/2213302D:VI)’s USDT recorded $13.3 trillion.
